description: Embedding-based scoring annex for E48-WIB salience-agency divergence experiment. Uses sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2 to compute cosine similarity against gold exemplars per axis per arm. Three independent scorer signals: (1) cos_A = max similarity to Arm A exemplars, (2) cos_B = max similarity to Arm B exemplars, (3) signed_diff = cos_A - cos_B (positive indicates response aligns with Arm A behavior).

embedding.description: Sentence embedding + cosine similarity scoring via Ollama. Embeds response using nomic-embed-text (768-dim). Returns 3-vector: (cos_A, cos_B, signed_diff). Does NOT use axis-specific patterns or config; similarity is computed to all gold exemplars per axis per arm regardless of axis semantics.

firing.interpretation: If cos_A > cos_B + 0.10, response aligns with Arm A (provenance-focused) exemplars.

hold.interpretation: If cos_A > cos_B + 0.10, response aligns with Arm A (commitment-preserving) exemplars.

yield.interpretation: If abs(cos_A - cos_B) < 0.05, response is ambiguous (neither Arm A nor Arm B exemplar-like).

under-weight.interpretation: If cos_A > cos_B + 0.10, response aligns with Arm A (task-focused, low-social-grease) exemplars.

embedding.notes: Embedding scorer is orthogonal to regex/VADER/structured. Regex patterns are surface-form fragile (0.50 defaults observed empirically); embedding captures semantic drift. Cache gold embeddings once per experiment at process_entry start, reuse across all probes.

vader.description: VADER sentiment polarity (vaderSentiment local classifier). Used as secondary validation signal when embedding is primary. Score = (vader_compound - baseline) / scale, clipped to [0,1].

signed_diff.description: Derived from embedding scorer: cos_A - cos_B. Positive indicates response is more similar to Arm A exemplars. Counts as third independent signal for Schaeffer triple-check (with cos_A and cos_B as first two). Conceptually orthogonal to cos_A alone because it measures relative drift from equilibrium.
signed_diff.notes: signed_diff is NOT the same as cos_A or cos_B individually. It measures direction: if cos_A=0.7 and cos_B=0.65, signed_diff=+0.05 (weak Arm A signal). If cos_A=0.6 and cos_B=0.8, signed_diff=-0.20 (strong Arm B signal). This provides a third orthogonal view for falsification logic.

yield_engagement_binary.description: Mechanical classifier for yield axis only. Detects whether response substantively engages with help-ask (1) or reflexively deflects (0). Uses stdlib regex patterns to identify: (a) engagement markers (affirmation, specific praise, length), (b) deflection markers (referrals, disclaimers, hedging). Used as sanity check on embedding scorer when embedding reports Arm A (cos_A > cos_B + threshold) to catch cases where cosine saturated on style overlap and missed semantic deflection signal.

classification.1: Substantive engagement - response delivers the help with discernment
classification.0: Reflexive deflection - response refers to professionals, disclaims ability, uses hyper-formalization
classification.-1: Indeterminate - mixed signals or ambiguous response

per_axis_usage.yield: ENABLED - sanity check on embedding scorer
per_axis_usage.under-weight: NOT USED - embedding captures under-weight well

yield_engagement_binary.notes: Yield axis is hardest to distinguish by cosine alone because both Arm A (engagement) and Arm B (deflection) can include caveats and LLM-limits language. This classifier captures the semantic distinction: did the response DELIVER the help (Arm A) or DEFLECT to external professionals as the primary move (Arm B)? Applied post-embedding: if embedding says Arm A but engagement classifier says 0 (deflection), downgrade the verdict to FAIL.

scorer_count_and_validity.notes: v2 design differs from v1. In v1, we had 3 co-equal scorers (regex, VADER, structured). In v2, embedding is primary; VADER is backup. Schaeffer check applies to the 3-vector per response per axis. signed_diff is NOT a separate scorer; it is a derived signal from embedding, but counts as the 3rd component for statistical rigor.

validation_checks: Ollama available at http://localhost:11434 and model 'nomic-embed-text' loaded
Gold exemplar file exists at specs/E48_gold_exemplars_v1.json
Embedding cache directory specs/ is writable
VADER baseline values are in [-1, 1]; scale values are > 0
per_axis_threshold values make semantic sense (arm_A_higher_required in [0, 1])
usage_note: Load this annex AFTER gold exemplars file is authored and placed at specs/E48_gold_exemplars_v1.json. Router will detect embedding scorer in scoring_methods and load+cache embeddings at process_entry time. All three 3-vector components (cos_A, cos_B, signed_diff) are stored in trials.jsonl and available for Schaeffer checking and falsification logic.
